map.光程差 Δ = (n_e − n_o) × d，正交偏振下干涉色由光程差决定。: Optical path difference Δ = (n_e − n_o) × d; the interference color under crossed polarization is determined by the optical path difference.
map.镜片装配应力要求：中心区 ≤ 一级黄(约300nm)，边缘螺钉处 ≤ 二级绿(约: Lens assembly stress requirements: central zone ≤ first-order yellow (about 300 nm), edge screw points ≤ second-order green (about 700 nm). Zero order (black/gray) means no birefringence or negligible stress.
map.干涉色判读需在标准正交偏光仪(钠光589.3nm参考)下进行，颜色判断带主观性，: Interference color interpretation must be done under a standard crossed polariscope (with sodium light 589.3 nm reference); color judgment is subjective and the result is for initial screening of assembly quality only.
map.偏光镜下看装配应力与双折射。: View assembly stress and birefringence under a polariscope.
map.偏光+标准灯下无彩纹=应力合格；框压处现彩色条纹且随转镜变化=机械应力，需松框。: No color fringes under a polariscope + standard lamp = stress acceptable; color fringes at the frame pressure point changing with lens rotation = mechanical stress, requiring loosening the frame.
map.应力 0–3 级，≤1 通过；高折/PC 片对应力更敏感，装配力矩须控小。: Stress grades 0-3, ≤1 passes; high-index/PC lenses are more stress-sensitive, so assembly torque must be kept low.
map.本质都是双折射，偏光法最直观显彩纹；与镀膜应力叠加会加重视觉畸变。: Essentially all are birefringence; the polarized method most directly shows color fringes; superimposed with coating stress it aggravates visual distortion.
map.装配过紧的应力靠重装松框消除；材料内应力需退火，装配层只能控夹力。: Stress from over-tight assembly is eliminated by reinstalling with a looser frame; internal material stress requires annealing, and at the assembly level only the clamping force can be controlled.
